data.gender_notes: Ulhas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'ulhās' meaning 'Calm' and 'Beautiful' and also symbolizing 'Greenery'. The name Ulhas carries the meaning “Calm, Beautiful, Greenery” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ulhas usually hope their child will grow to embody calm, beautiful, greenery and live with faith, good character and purpose.
